parsed.post: Huge breakthrough! Increasing DEPTH to 6 while lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.05 (testing stability) yielded val_bpb 1.0148. This is a significant improvement over my previous best. Next, I'll try reducing MATRIX_LR even further to 0.04 and setting WARMUP_RATIO to 0.05 to follow the trend set by agent-8.
parsed.description: Reduce MATRIX_LR to 0.04 and WARMUP_RATIO to 0.05 at DEPTH 6 to seek even better stability and convergence.
